when: [[tal:Shaman:0:15|Elemental Mastery]] is neither up nor ready
notes: Troll. Berserking once [[tal:Shaman:0:15|Elemental Mastery]] has run out: under it the bolts are 1.5 sec casts and the GCD takes the haste.
why: Waits until Elemental Mastery ends. During Mastery, Lightning Bolt already casts as fast as the global cooldown allows, so the haste is wasted.

name: Earth Shock

name: Lightning Shield
when: Lightning Shield is not up and at least 50% mana and over 60s of the fight left

name: Downranked Lightning Bolt (Rank 8)

notes: To make the mana last. Not on [[tal:Shaman:0:6|Clearcasting]], which makes the top rank free.
why: Why rank 8? It's the lowest rank that keeps its full spell power coefficient at 60. Rank 7 keeps only 75%.
